notes: Look presets for the explainer style. `look` holds the look fields a preset implies (theme; the recipe is derived as look-<id>), `knobs` the style-recipe knobs applied to the middle scenes (styles/vocabulary.py closed sets), `emphasis` the scene types the writer is asked to prefer, `registry` the HyperFrames registry items the look is built with (installed under hf_template_explainer/compositions, adapted inline in index.html), `thumbnail` a path under newsletter_video/ui/static.

presets.name: Clean paper
presets.description: The default editorial look: warm paper, one cobalt accent, serif headlines, dot grid. Exactly today's daily video.
presets.good_for: Every story. The daily default: clean, readable, no surprises.

presets.name: Cinematic dark glass
presets.description: Near-black ground with drifting aurora fields, a grid floor, grain, glass panels, neon 3D stacks and bars; scenes dissolve and push in slowly. (The mesh-gradient shader background is installed and works in stills; set background 'mesh-gradient' on a scene to use it once the CLI renders WebGPU blocks.)
presets.good_for: Big launches, hardware and AI model news that want drama and depth.

presets.name: Depth cards
presets.description: Dark theme: processes and timelines become glass planes the camera dollies through, stacks and hubs become 3D objects; scenes slide in from the right with a parallax hold.
presets.good_for: Product and app stories with screens, diagrams and layered comparisons.

presets.name: Data focus
presets.description: Dark ground with heavy sans headlines, hard wipes and popping bars: charts and comparisons become 3D columns standing on a grid floor, lit from inside.
presets.good_for: Numbers: funding rounds, benchmarks, market shares, anything with a chart.

presets.name: Glow type
presets.description: Cinematic ground with magenta and cyan neon, letters stepping in, caps everywhere, a pulse on the hold: kinetic type carries the story.
presets.good_for: Hot takes and one-line announcements where the words are the picture.

presets.name: Quiet editorial
presets.description: The paper look slowed down: cross-fades, soft fade-ups and a floating hold for quotes, timelines and considered statements.
presets.good_for: Opinion, interviews and timelines that read better slowly.
